scope: Three parallel work packages were integrated on testing; this evidence does not close M3 or M4.

m3DynamicCatalog.meaning: Speech synthesis discovery remains bound to verified descriptor/component identity when the visible model name changes; it does not prove runtime generation quality.

m3TerminalRecovery.meaning: A worker finishing after the same terminal state was persisted succeeds idempotently; a different state remains fail-closed. File-lock release semantics are preserved.

m4AsrResourceKey.meaning: Equivalent Qwen3-ASR workloads share a resource key across session/result/version identities while snapshot digests remain distinct; this is a resource-key regression, not real ASR quality or execution acceptance.

projectMediaAccess.meaning: An active project session can obtain a short-lived ticket for an archived media asset, served by immutable source session/result identity after the producer session closes; desktop UI consumption remains pending.

remaining: M3 MoE/A42/tool and cross-task contention acceptance
M4 real ASR/TTS/image/video execution and quality acceptance
desktop project-media ticket consumption and playback/save/reveal location flow
natural-language local edits with typed region/time-range scope
same-condition acceleration benchmark and long-run stability
